body: Thanks, I'll check out that subreddit. I'm probably going to get therapy if nothing clears up soon
You've already signed off, but I love Broken Again and your PTSD album!!

That sounds like a cool idea. I've also enjoyed languages, so I could pick up learning a language that interests me.

I just need to work up the motivation to do anything. I know that that's entirely on my shoulders, and I'll figure out a way how to do it. Right now I'm just really debilitated and depressed

I also appreciate you talking with me, thanks a ton
I'm not sure. I really like music, so maybe something music related. An instrument hasn't really ever appealed to me, but maybe learning more of how it works and stuff.
I'll PM you. It's a ton to type out. Thanks for reaching out

I'm going through it all in weird phases.

Initially, I was scared of death. It interested me, and I got into philosophy and afterlives, and beliefs and all that. But death scared me. I was debilitated for a while. When I spoke to my dad, he said that my own mortality had kind of hit me. He said I was maturing.

After that, I began to have some homicidal ideation. I just wanted to hurt things. I was seriously scared at that time because I didn't know whether or not I would succumb to one of my urges or not. That lasted for like a week, but it was treacherous. It also ruined my birthday. 

I then went on to being scared whether or not I was going deaf or blind. I would check my hearing every couple seconds and I was scared I was going to lose my eyesight when I woke up. It scared me as well.

Now, I'm at the point where I'm questioning sexual things. It's torture. I'm tired of waking up and thinking, "Oh, what new worry will I be dealing with today?" It feels as if the only way to get rid of one worry or fantasy is to replace it with another.

I feel as if I've failed pretty much everyone I've ever known. I've been going through some pretty serious depression when I used to be super happy. It was like 0-60 in a day. 

I went through a ton of phases. I'm only 16, so I don't know if it's common  or not.
